certname.description: The unique identifier (FQDN or custom name) for this Puppet node. Must be unique per agent and match DNS/Cert SANs.

subject_alt_names.description: List of DNS alt names to include in the SSL certificate request (e.g., ['puppet.example.com', 'puppet'] ). Must include at least the certname.

server_hostname.description: Hostname (or DNS alias) of the primary Puppet server. Used for configuration retrieval and reporting.

ca_server_hostname.description: Hostname of the dedicated Puppet CA server (optional; defaults to same as server_hostname if not set). Leave empty to use the same server.

ca_enabled.description: Whether to use the built-in Puppet CA to sign node certificates. Set to false if using an external CA (e.g., ACM, HashiCorp Vault).

cert_revocation_enabled.description: Whether to enable certificate revocation checking using CRLs. Requires a configured CA and valid CRL distribution points.
